profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Veronica Morales is a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer with expertise in multiple programming languages, including Java, Go, Scala, and Python. With a strong background in backend development and a proficiency in various frameworks such as Spring and Play, Veronica has contributed to the success of prominent companies such as Candy Digital, Bloomberg, L.P., Disney Streaming Services, and MLB. She possesses extensive knowledge in database management systems, including Oracle, Posgres, DynamoDB, and Cassandra, and is well-versed in utilizing AWS services for cloud-based applications. Veronica's expertise extends to building REST/RPC APIs, implementing data analytics solutions, and employing CI/CD tools like Git and Jenkins. With a proven track record in delivering high-quality software solutions, Veronica brings a wealth of experience and technical acumen to any development team. She holds a BA in Computer Science and Mathematics from Smith College and has actively volunteered as a mentor and tutor in technology-related programs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented customer engagement and loyalty backend features using gRPC for front end interface and a PostgreSQL backend using SQLC for query generation.
•	Contributed to state machine implementation for an ACHQ implementation that allowed users to withdraw USD into their bank accounts.
•	Designed queries to create Redshift views for admin and product teams to consume via Looker for data analytics.
positions.insights: Skills: Looker (Software) · Go (Programming Language) · gRPC · SQLC · SQL · ACHQ · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Bloomberg Vault
positions.locationName: Greater New York City Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
•	Contributed to Scala and Java based projects using Spring framework in support of the Bloomberg Vault & Surveillance applications.
•	Implemented REST APIs in Java/Spring and Scala/Play to generate reports programmatically in CSV, XLS and PDF formats. 
•	Contributed Spark SQL implementation responsible for gathering and processing data from a Cassandra store.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · REST · REST APIs · Scala · Play Framework · Cassandra · SQL

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed, implemented, and deployed various REST microservices responsible for payments and billing using Java, Spring framework and AWS resources.
•	Lead for team responsible for billing applications which integrate with various payment providers.  Distribute workload and mentor on all aspects of our dev pipeline.
•	Designed and implemented expanding our DynamoDB/KMS credit card tokens for multi-region use.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed, implemented, deployed and maintained features for a customer service tool (CST)  used by MLB partners.  CST is built with the Spring framework using Hibernate for database integration, Spring Boot for packaging/launch/embedded tomcat, REST based back end API and Angular JS front end.
•	Contributed to design, development and deployment of back end PCI secured rest services, to the AWS cloud.  
•      Worked on deploying cloudformation stacks for applications using templates created by sparkleformation.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Responsible for developer support of e-Commerce Spring based website built on hybris 4.6 Commerce Suite

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to the design and implementation of 3 major Lotus software products: IBM Workplace, a web-based J2EE mail and calendaring product; IBM Sametime, an Eclipse based instant messaging product; IBM Connections, a social software for business, Web 2.0 (REST) suite of applications for collaboration.
Contributed to various releases of the above products, going through full product lifecycle for each using agile development process.
For IBM Workplace, implemented directory component with JNDI\LDAP services, developed ANT scripts for automated deployment of J2EE ear applications to Websphere, implemented JDBC SQL statements for user provisioning and also assisted in development of the Mail Transfer Agent (MTA) using POP3\IMAP protocols.
For IBM Sametime, designed and implemented Eclipse plugins for directory and policy services, file transfer and audio\video.  Implemented the AV transport using RTP protocols and H.263\H.264 video codecs from a third party provider, Global IP Sound (GIPS), using JNI\C++ interface.  Worked for 3 years with the external provider to resolve issues on our end and theirs.
For IBM Connections, contributed to both back-end and front-end development, developed using the IBM iWidget framework.  Implemented REST APIs, Struts Actions, XSL translations, and JS.

positions.description: Worked in the colleges IT service department, servicing computer equipment and printers (A+ Certification).

patents.title: Method of protecting a computing system from harmful active content in documents
patents.description: Described are a system and method for protecting a computing device from potentially harmful code in a document. One or more definitions of potentially harmful active content are provided in an editable text file. The document is compared with each definition of potentially harmful active content in the editable text file to identify potentially harmful active content within the document. The document is modified to render harmless any identified potentially harmful active content before presenting the document to the computing device.
